sentences.en: We were delayed by traffic congestion, so we had to hurry.
sentences.zh: 由于交通拥堵，我们被耽搁了，所以我们不得不赶紧走。

sentences.en: Congestion in the capital, Algiers, costs Algeria billions in lost revenue.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及尔的交通拥堵使该国损失了数十亿美元的收入。

sentences.en: During the cold there were nasal congestion, sinus problems, and coughing.
sentences.zh: 感冒期间有鼻塞、头痛和咳嗽等症状。

senses.zh: 拥挤，堵车,阻塞,充血,（人口）过剩，稠密

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（加强）+gest（带来）+ ion →带来很多→拥塞
